notes: Hidden 'Recovery Password' now runs MetaMax-style over pure HTTP (no browser window): finds the account, emails the reset code, reads it, sets the new password and captures the live session cookie - fast, low-data, invisible. FIXED: the recovered session cookie + new password are now actually saved into Account Info (a silent error previously lost the cookie on every password recovery). NEW 100% finisher: if the request engine can't complete a step (captcha wall, rate-limited IP, or a screen it can't drive), an invisible off-screen browser finishes the recovery automatically - only a genuine 'no account' is skipped.
